items.pet_policy: Guide dogs or service animals are only allowed if the owner presents documentation proving their use for such services upon arrival. A room cleaning fee must be paid per stay, and an open voucher must be left in case of any damage.
items.parking_description: The parking lot is available for our guests with a 190.00 MXN fee per night. Parking lot is off-site, just four minutes away from our main entrance.
items.description: Experience the cultural richness and warm hospitality of Merida at Holiday Inn Express Merida Centro, a space designed to blend comfort, functionality, and a privileged location. Set in the heart of the city, the hotel is just steps away from iconic landmarks such as the Cathedral of San Ildefonso, Casa Montejo Museum, the Mayan Museum, Santa Lucia Park, Paseo de Montejo, and the vibrant local life that makes the city a truly unique destination. Enjoy spacious and modern rooms with every convenience, from complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi to a daily buffet breakfast. Unwind by our refreshing outdoor pool or stay active in the gym. For business needs, we offer fully equipped meeting spaces and a 24-hour business center, ensuring productivity without leaving the comfort of the hotel. Plan day trips to nearby wonders such as Chichen Itza, Uxmal, Valladolid, or the beaches of Celestun. Savor local cuisine, stroll through artisan markets, and immerse yourself in the traditions of Yucatan. Stay with us in downtown Merida and discover the city at your own pace.

items.pet_policy: Only dogs are allowed. Dogs must arrive clean and wearing a flea collar to check in at reception. Guests will be informed about the designated walking area and waste disposal area. Only standard rooms, 401 through 409, are allowed. Charges are per dog.
items.parking_description: Outdoor parking. Free parking for guests. If not a guest then the cost will be of $ 18.00 MXN per hour.
items.description: Nestled in the vibrant center of downtown Mérida, Holiday Inn Mérida offers proximity to the airport, cultural attractions, and scenic gems, allowing you to experience the historic charm and local traditions of Yucatán with ease. Explore iconic sites like Museo Casa Montejo, the Mayan ruins of Chichén-Itzá, and the archaeological site of Uxmal. Marvel at Cathedral Mérida and Monumento a la Patria and embrace history at the Mayan World Museum of Mérida - all just minutes away. Delight in flavorful on-site dining paired with live music and stunning views, enjoy a relaxing day at our outdoor pool and lounge area, and recharge in our fully equipped Fitness Center. Take advantage of convenient onsite parking, access to our Business Center, and complimentary Wi-Fi. After a day of exploration, unwind in guest rooms with plush bedding and refreshing air conditioning for ultimate comfort. Enjoy a seamless stay in Mérida with the comfort you expect and the exceptional service you deserve.

items.description: Welcome to the Crowne Plaza Mérida, a hotel with incredible rooms. Our pet-friendly hotel is the best choice for luxury accommodations in the city, offering a prime location, exceptional services, and unique spaces for weddings, groups, and medium-sized conventions. Located on Av. Prolongación Paseo de Montejo, a modern area home to major corporate offices, near a wide variety of specialty restaurants, shopping centers, museums, and countless tourist attractions, Crowne Plaza Mérida captivates its guests with modern and comfortable rooms equipped with air conditioning, blackout curtains, coffee makers, tea kettles, and high-definition TVs. Whether you’re traveling solo, with friends, or with the whole family, you’ll always enjoy unparalleled services, such as free high-speed Wi-Fi and access to our heated outdoor pool, our fitness center, and our Aroma Lima restaurant. Our guests are just a few minutes drive from impressive sites such as the Great Museum of the Mayan World, the Uxmal Archaeological Zone, Celestún, Mérida's Plaza Grande, the CIC, Siglo XXI (Convention Center), and much more. Thank you for choosing the Crowne Plaza Mérida as your home away from home in Mexico. We are delighted to welcome you and make your stay unforgettable.

items.description: Modern Merida Hotel with Beautiful Outdoor Pool The Holiday Inn Express® Merida Hotel welcomes visitors to Yucatán’s capital city with legendary hospitality. Whether you're here to explore our captivating Mayan heritage or you're immersed in a business trip, the Holiday Inn Express is the ideal place to stay. Our location places you within walking distance of Siglo XXI Convention Center and near different businesses such as PricewaterhouseCoppers. This business-class hotel helps you stay productive throughout your trip. We offer complimentary Internet access in all our facilities, a 24-hour Business Center and different event spaces. Enjoy your trip to the fullest by combing business with pleasure. From the hotel, all of Yucatán’s main attractions are easily accessible due to our nearness to Mexico-261 and Mexico-281 Highways. Stay within the city and spend an afternoon visiting the major historic destinations around Plaza Mayor in downtown Merida or strolling through Paseo Montejo. The hotel is specially designed to maximize your comfort. Our modern spaces include a relaxing guest patio with a sparkling outdoor pool and a well-equipped Fitness Center. Start each day with a hearty, free hot and cold breakfast; and later, end the day in a minimalist styled comfortable room with 37-inch plasma TV.

items.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn & Suites Mérida La Isla, ideally located within La Isla Mérida Cabo Norte, one of the city's premier lifestyle destinations. Surrounded by upscale shopping, dining, entertainment, and corporate offices, our hotel offers convenient access to Mérida International Airport, the U.S. Consulate, major hospitals, universities, and leading business districts. Whether traveling for business, leisure, medical appointments, or extended stays, you'll enjoy a strategic location in northern Mérida. Experience the best of the destination just minutes away. Stay near Foro GNP Mérida and Auditorio Coca-Cola La Isla, two of the city's top venues for concerts and live entertainment. The hotel is also close to the Yucatán International Congress Center, Siglo XXI Convention Center, Gran Museo del Mundo Maya, Paseo de Montejo, Mérida's Historic Center, and the Dzibilchaltún Archaeological Zone, making it an ideal choice for conventions, corporate events, cultural experiences, and family vacations. Relax in spacious guestrooms and suites, many featuring kitchenettes for extended stays. Enjoy complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, a 24-hour Fitness Center, business center, underground parking, flexible meeting space, Andrómeda Restaurant, Orión Bar, and a complimentary one-way shuttle within a 10 km radius, subject to availability. Holiday Inn & Suites Mérida La Isla combines comfort, convenience, and exceptional service for every stay.
